requirements.outcome: File → New creates a named project directory, organized child folders, and an initial .opr inside it.
requirements.implementation_note: The dialog creates Audio/Recordings, Audio/Imports, and Metadata, and rejects an existing project directory.

requirements.outcome: OpenTrack starts with only its menu bar and no project, Project window, Mixer, transport, or status panel.
requirements.implementation_note: The app starts with project_open=false and gates project content/windows until a managed project is created or opened.

requirements.outcome: New and legacy-project folder flows use the native Windows folder picker and offer creation of a new project folder.
requirements.implementation_note: File → New picks a parent using rfd's Windows folder dialog; migration offers current, beside, new-child, and selected existing-folder destinations.

requirements.outcome: Older projects prompt to use the current folder or choose/create another folder without silently replacing the source project.
requirements.implementation_note: Projects with missing version metadata or missing expected directories trigger migration choices; moving or importing legacy formats writes a new .opr. Selecting the same folder for an old .opr explicitly upgrades that file in place.

requirements.outcome: The application title is Project- followed by the current .opr filename stem.
requirements.implementation_note: The native viewport title updates when the current project path changes.

requirements.outcome: Record writes numbered audio takes inside Audio/Recordings without asking for a file destination.
requirements.implementation_note: Numbered take names avoid existing files; multi-track takes have per-track names.

requirements.outcome: External WAV imports are copied under Audio/Imports without overwriting same-named media.
requirements.implementation_note: Copying runs on a worker thread to a unique temporary path and renames into a unique destination after copying.

requirements.outcome: A newly saved/opened project with no edits closes without an unsaved-changes prompt.
requirements.implementation_note: Existing saved fingerprints govern the close prompt; folder creation writes and marks the initial project saved.

requirements.outcome: Older supported OPR versions open without rewriting the saved source, and failed opens show a visible error from the empty shell.

new-project-workflow.description: New project creation yields the expected folder, file, title, and no-overwrite behavior.

startup-shell.description: A fresh launch shows the menu bar with no project content or child panels open.

native-folder-dialogs.description: New and legacy-project flows open the Windows folder picker and create/select the requested destination.

migration-safety.description: A disposable old project can migrate, reopen, and retain the source when copied elsewhere.

media-containment.description: Imported WAVs and recorded takes land in the expected managed subfolders and reopen correctly.

clean-close.description: An unchanged managed project closes without a save prompt.

native-compatibility.description: User opens actual saved EXAMPLE and sees its project/media; invalid files show visible errors without replacing the current project.
